title: Linear Algebra
description: This module covers linear algebra which underpins many applications of computing involving analysis of aggregated data in vector or matrix form. Applications span graphics, robotics, performance engineering, operations research, and statistical machine learning.
learning_objectives: Solve systems of linear equations using Gaussian elimination
Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors for simple matrices and explain their application
Define projections and rotations in matrix form
Find the spectral decomposition of real symmetric matrices
topics: Solution of linear systems of equations
